claim: Unicorn Factory Lisboa announced the winners of its 2026 Entrepreneurship Awards on 27 October.
The awards ceremony was held at the Técnico Innovation Center in Lisbon.
Unicorn Factory Lisboa's awards announcement took place on its fourth anniversary.
Algarve Evolution is based in Faro and began in 2018 as a group of local entrepreneurs.
Algarve Evolution's targets for 2032 are 500 companies supported, 150 new startups, and 50,000 people reached.
Vasco Lopes is the former CEO of DeepNeuronic, which was acquired by Motorola Solutions.
Rita Barbosa is the founder of Guardian Labs EU.
RTBeamTech is a spin-off from LIP and Instituto Superior Técnico.
An Informa D&B study presented in November 2025 counted 115 startups in the Algarve in 2024.
Of the Algarve's startups in 2024, 78% were in information technology and communications, and 95% were microenterprises with fewer than 10 people.
Algarve startup turnover grew 29% a year from 2021 to 2024, against 24.2% for startups nationally.
Founder2Founder selected eight companies from 41 applications.
